items.title: Christa Pike in critical condition after surviving two lethal injections, lawyer says
items.description: Pike’s lawyers have asked for her death sentence to be commuted following the botched execution.

items.title: Netanyahu says Flydubai attacker had 'Islamist radical indoctrination'
items.description: Israel's prime minister says the pilot who tried to take over the Flydubai plane clearly intended to "down the plane".

items.title: Putin warns West that Russia is ready to use every weapon to protect Kaliningrad
items.description: The Russian leader insists Moscow is "not threatening anyone" and is merely responding to statements by Western leaders.

items.title: Renee Good: Family of US woman killed by ICE agent sues Trump officials
items.description: Lawyers for Good's family say US officials created "an unprecedented environment for state sponsored violence" in Minneapolis.

items.title: Russian dissident Garry Kasparov says US warned him of danger to his life
items.description: "My family and I will not truly be safe as long as Putin is in power," says the former chess world champion.

items.title: Trump's AI rebrand causes 'unprecedented' demand for Slovenian website names
items.description: The president wants AI to be called super intelligence - or SI - the same initials used by Slovenian domains.

items.title: Japan raises permanent residency fee by 20 times
items.description: The hikes are part of immigration policy changes introduced to manage Japan's growing foreign population.

items.title: Fires break out at French schools as students protest nationwide
items.description: The French government holds a crisis meeting as demonstrations grow and become violent in places.

items.title: Kanye West's Russia shows officially cancelled after weeks of uncertainty
items.description: Chaos has surrounded the St Petersburg shows since the stadium said it had not agreed to host the rapper.

items.title: Algeria introduces death penalty for arsonists after deadly wildfires
items.description: It is estimated more than 200 people have died in blazes in the north-east of the country over the summer.

items.title: K-pop star convicted of violating military service law
items.description: The member of K-pop band Winner was given a suspended prison sentence for repeated absences from his national service work.
